summary.tagline: Ancient woodlands and historic deer herds in London's largest National Nature Reserve.
summary.seo_title: Exploring Richmond Park: A 3-Day Nature Guide
aliases: London’s largest Site of Special Scientific Interest

travel.headline: Permits required for specialized activities like fishing
travel.reservation: Fishing requires a permit and traction kiting requires a licence. Check current visitor access and activity requirements with The Royal Parks before planning your visit.

days.title: Historic Vistas and Garden Oases
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM at King Henry’s Mound

stops.name: King Henry’s Mound
stops.detail: Visit the highest point in the park to admire protected views stretching over ten miles to St. Paul’s Cathedral.

stops.name: Pembroke Lodge
stops.detail: Visit this Georgian mansion for tea and stroll through its gardens, which offer sweeping views of the Thames Valley.

days.note: Suggested pacing is for a leisurely day of walking and sightseeing.

days.title: Wildlife and Wetland Landscapes

stops.name: Pen Ponds
stops.detail: Visit Pen Ponds for wildlife photography; keep at least 50 metres away from deer.

stops.name: Isabella Plantation
stops.detail: Walk the woodland paths of this 40-acre oasis, known for its streams and vibrant azalea collection.

days.driving: Transfer time is not established by the supplied sources; check access and walking routes before departure.
days.note: Keep at least 50m away from deer and use long lenses for photography.

days.title: Circuit Treks and Family Trails

stops.name: Tamsin Trail
stops.detail: Follow the seven-mile perimeter route popular with hikers and joggers for a full view of the park's grasslands.

stops.name: Petersham Gate Playground
stops.detail: A family stop with swings and slides.

days.note: The Tamsin Trail is a multi-use path; remain alert for joggers and cyclists.

intel.title: Seasonal Landscapes
intel.text: Visit in spring to see the azalea extravaganza at Isabella Plantation. Autumn offers a chance to see the 600-strong deer herds during the rut.

intel.title: Recreational Licensing
intel.text: While walking is free, fishing and traction kiting are strictly regulated by permits. Check the Royal Parks website for current application procedures.

plan.vehicle: While roads exist, cycling and walking are primary ways to experience the Tamsin Trail; check local vehicle restrictions for larger RVs.
plan.goldenHour: King Henry’s Mound is the recommended spot for evening light over the London skyline, though specific sunset times vary by season.
